## Names

<a id="sfx_sample_table"></a>
### [`sfx_sample_table`](../../../../src/sfx/sfx_samples_f540.asm#L6) `$F540-$F54F`

*data*

Sample table: entries of (start, end) offsets from $f540. sfx_sample_start ($3186) adds $f540 and plays the bytes from start to end, both included. Only entries 0-3 hold samples. The range $f540-$ff3f is the floor, bitmap rows 17-24. All four floor colours are 7 ($192f, NMI $2ff2), so the sample bytes do not show.
Entry 0: $f580-$f663, for hit reaction $16, the knockdown ($2ce7).

- **Referred to by:** [`sfx_play_sample_7`](sfx_sample_player.md#sfx_play_sample_7) [`$3198`](../../../../src/sfx/sfx_sample_player.asm#L91), [`sfx_play_sample_7`](sfx_sample_player.md#sfx_play_sample_7) [`$319B`](../../../../src/sfx/sfx_sample_player.asm#L92), [`sfx_play_sample_7`](sfx_sample_player.md#sfx_play_sample_7) [`$319F`](../../../../src/sfx/sfx_sample_player.asm#L94), [`sfx_play_sample_7`](sfx_sample_player.md#sfx_play_sample_7) [`$31A2`](../../../../src/sfx/sfx_sample_player.asm#L95), [`sfx_play_sample_7`](sfx_sample_player.md#sfx_play_sample_7) [`$31A7`](../../../../src/sfx/sfx_sample_player.asm#L98), [`sfx_play_sample_7`](sfx_sample_player.md#sfx_play_sample_7) [`$31AA`](../../../../src/sfx/sfx_sample_player.asm#L99), [`sfx_play_sample_7`](sfx_sample_player.md#sfx_play_sample_7) [`$31AE`](../../../../src/sfx/sfx_sample_player.asm#L101), [`sfx_play_sample_7`](sfx_sample_player.md#sfx_play_sample_7) [`$31B1`](../../../../src/sfx/sfx_sample_player.asm#L102)

<a id="sfx_sample_knockdown"></a>
### [`sfx_sample_knockdown`](../../../../src/sfx/sfx_samples_f540.asm#L21) `$F580-$F662`

*data*

Sample 0, $f580-$f663 (228 bytes, about 0.08 s): hit reaction $16, the knockdown ($2ce7). Each sample byte selects a timer B count (sfx_period_hi/lo). sfx_sample_irq ($311a) toggles the volume at each count, so the bytes are the lengths of the half waves.

<a id="sfx_sample_hit"></a>
### [`sfx_sample_hit`](../../../../src/sfx/sfx_samples_f540.asm#L52) `$F663-$F978`

*data*

Sample 1, $f663-$f979 (791 bytes, about 0.46 s): hit reactions $1a and $1b ($2cdc, $2cf2) and the bull hit ($13b7). Its first byte is the last byte of sample 0.
